11-2B-1. - Purpose.
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT11UNDECO_CH2DIRE_ARTBCODI_11-2B-1PU","Title":"11-2B-1. - Purpose.","Content":"
\n

\n The purpose of the commercial districts is to provide for the retail and service needs\n of the community in accordance with the Meridian Comprehensive Plan. The following\n districts are designated which differ in the size and scale of commercial structures\n accommodated in the district, the scale and mix of allowed commercial uses, and the\n location of the district in proximity to streets and highways:\n

\n

\n TABLE 11-2B-1\n
\n PURPOSE AND ALLOWED USE BY COMMERCIAL DISTRICT\n \n

\n
\n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n
\n District\n \n Allowed Uses\n \n Location\n
\n Neighborhood Business District (C-N)\n \n Small scale convenience with limited hours of operation\n \n Access to arterial or collector\n
\n Community Business District (C-C)\n \n Larger scale and broader mix of retail, office, and service uses\n \n Access to arterials or nonresidential collectors\n
\n General Retail and Service Commercial District (C-G)\n \n Largest scale and broadest mix of retail, office, service, and light industrial uses\n \n Close proximity and/or access to interstate or arterial intersections\n
\n Limited Office District (L-O)\n \n Office centers and adaptive reuse of residential structures with limited hours of\n operation\n \n Access to arterial or collector\n
\n Mixed Employment (M-E)\n \n Offices, medical centers, research and development facilities, and light industrial\n uses with ancillary support services\n \n Access to arterial or collector\n
\n High Density Employment (H-E)\n \n Corporate headquarters, office complexes, research and development facilities and\n complementary services such as conference centers and hospitality use with limited\n retail\n \n Close proximity to Federal and State highway interchanges and major arterials\n
\n
\n

 

\n
\n \n

\n (Ord. 08-1372, 7-8-2008, eff. 7-8-2008)\n
